cpsFeature.note: Platform BEHAVIOR of the embedded demo is governed by chrome-platform-showcase's own immutable conformance contract at conformanceRoute. gendn references it and does not fork or contradict its assertions.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v151/cross-origin-redirect-timing-opt-in/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page carries its canonical chromestatus.com/feature/5078310347472896 link — the immutable feature identity (CLAUDE.md invariant #3) and the milestone-151 mapping's self-heal.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v151/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).

Embedded live example points at THIS feature's chrome-platform-showcase route (chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v151/cross-origin-redirect-timing-opt-in...) — the canonical demo identity, never repointed.

The embedded chrome-platform-showcase demo actually renders (not a blank box or error frame); its platform behavior is governed by the CPS conformance contract referenced in cpsFeature, not re-asserted here.
The four stable reference routes (Timing-Allow-Origin header + redirectCount/redirectStart/redirectEnd attributes) resolve with HTTP 200 on this origin.
assertions.test: (async () => { const rs = await Promise.all(["timing-allow-origin/","redirectcount/","redirectstart/","redirectend/"].map(m => fetch('./' + m))); return rs.every(r => r.status === 200); })()

assertions.describe: Each member reference page renders all nine implementation dimensions with substantive text (40+ chars per section).
assertions.test: (async () => { const dims = ['syntax','inputs','outputs','errors','context','lifecycle','examples','compatibility','security-privacy']; for (const m of ["timing-allow-origin/","redirectcount/","redirectstart/","redirectend/"]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + m)).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html'); for (const d of dims) { const el = doc.getElementById(d); if (!el || el.parentElement.textContent.trim().length < 40) return false; } } return true; })()

assertions.describe: The feature overview links every inventory member route (implementation-sufficiency: overview explains the model and links every item).

Executable doc-quality check: the header page documents the forward/destination-origin opt-in, the every-redirect chain rule, and the no-referrer exclusion; the attribute pages document the redirect-count-gated getter behavior (0 when count is 0).
assertions.test: (async () => { const h = (await (await fetch('./timing-allow-origin/')).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/destination origin/i.test(h) || !/every redirect/i.test(h) || !/no-referrer/i.test(h)) return false; for (const m of ['redirectstart/','redirectend/']) { const t = (await (await fetch('./' + m)).text()).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/redirect count is 0/i.test(t)) return false; } return true; })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: interim feature support cites the ChromeStatus API record, general-property BCD files are linked separately and not conflated with the feature, and no page derives per-feature vendor views from core_enums.py.
assertions.test: (async () => { for (const p of ['', ...["timing-allow-origin/","redirectcount/","redirectstart/","redirectend/"]]) { const html = await (await fetch('./' + p)).text(); if (!html.includes('chromestatus.com/api/v0/features/5078310347472896')) return false; if (html.includes('core_enums.py')) return false; } return true; })()
